subject: 🏃 Wednesday — Heavy Strength at Lynx (Wk 5)
html:
Tomorrow: Heavy Strength at Lynx Fitness Club — the first normal-load heavy session since May 20. May 27 was taper-light (60% loads), and the bar's been waiting. Lynx opens at 5:30 AM — get in early and move with purpose. This is jet-lag day 3 and the morning after yesterday's 5-threshold-mile Esplanade session, so the standard Tue-run/Wed-lift split is in play but warm up thoroughly.

Dynamic warm-up (10 min): foam roll quads and IT band 1 min each, glute bridges 10 reps, quadruped hip CARs 3 each leg, bodyweight squats 10 reps, RDL pattern with empty bar 10 reps.

The session:

  • Back squat: 165 lb, 4×6, 3-sec eccentric — hips break first, knees track over toes
  • Romanian deadlift: 135 lb, 4×6, 3-sec eccentric — no straps this trip (confirmed Jun 1); 135 keeps the bar in your hands for clean hinge reps rather than grip-failing at 165. Neutral spine, hamstring stretch at the bottom
  • Standing calf raise: 40 lb/hand DBs, 4×10 off a step — full ROM, 2-sec hold at top, 3-sec lower. Lynx has a full DB rack — test 45 lb/hand if 40 feels clearly Easy (the Cañada KB-gap blocker is gone)
  • Reverse Nordic: BW, 3×10 — resumes today after the taper skip. Knees hip-width, glutes squeezed, 3-sec lower. Pick up where you left off (~45–60° depth range); don't force full mat depth on the first session back

Focus cue: own the 3-second eccentric on every squat rep. Jet lag and yesterday's threshold miles will have your legs feeling heavy — that's fine. A controlled, grinding 165-lb squat with perfect tempo is the whole point of the heavy day. Don't rush the descent to compensate for fatigue.

Context: Week 5 of 12, Phase 2 (Strength & Threshold) — 53 days to the SF Marathon. Knee has been 1/5 across every single V6 session, including yesterday's 5 threshold miles with bridge climbing on jet-lag day 2. That durability streak is the best signal of the build. If the knee is 2+ at the alarm, hold lower-body load — but there's no reason to expect that.

Tonight: Lights out by 10 PM ET. Lay out gym clothes and set a 5:15 AM alarm — Lynx at 5:30, lift for 45–50 min, back and showered before the work day. Log feel ratings for every exercise so we can track progression. Hydrate now — the post-threshold session + hotel air will have you dry.
